name: Exp_ColorHMA
summary: This EA trades based on the ColorHMA (Hull Moving Average) indicator, opening buy positions when the HMA slope turns upward and sell positions when it turns downward. It uses the color changes of the HMA to detect trend reversals and manages positions with configurable stop loss, take profit, and multiple money management modes. Trades are only executed on new bars to avoid redundant signals.
summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorHMA（赫尔移动平均线）指标进行交易，当HMA斜率向上翻转时开多仓，向下翻转时开空仓。它利用HMA的颜色变化来检测趋势反转，并通过可配置的止损、止盈和多种资金管理模式来管理仓位。交易仅在新K线形成时执行以避免重复信号。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于赫尔移动平均线（HMA）的趋势跟踪策略。入场条件为：当HMA值从前一根到当前一根上升（Value[0]>Value[1]）且前一根低于更前一根（Value[1]<Value[2]）时，产生买入信号；当HMA值从前一根到当前一根下降（Value[0]<Value[1]）且前一根高于更前一根（Value[1]>Value[2]）时，产生卖出信号。出场条件依赖固定点数的止损和止盈设置，同时支持反向信号平仓——当出现卖出信号时平掉多头仓位，出现买入信号时平掉空头仓位。仓位管理方面，支持五种模式：按可用保证金比例、按余额比例、按可用保证金扣除浮亏比例、按余额扣除浮亏比例、以及固定手数模式。资金管理通过MM参数和MMMode枚举控制下单量。EA还使用IsNewBar机制确保每个K线只计算一次信号，避免在同一个K线上重复开仓。SignalBar参数允许用户选择使用哪根K线的值来计算信号，默认为1即最近完成的K线。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is a trend-following approach based on the Hull Moving Average (HMA). Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when HMA values rise from the previous bar to the current bar (Value[0]>Value[1]) and the previous bar's value is below the bar before it (Value[1]<Value[2]); a sell signal is generated when HMA values decline from the previous bar to the current bar (Value[0]<Value[1]) and the previous bar's value is above the bar before it (Value[1]>Value[2]). Exit conditions rely on fixed stop loss and take profit settings in points, and also support reverse-signal closing — long positions are closed when a sell signal appears, and short positions are closed when a buy signal appears. Position sizing supports five modes: percentage of free margin, percentage of balance, percentage of free margin minus floating loss, percentage of balance minus floating loss, and fixed lot size. Money management is controlled via the MM parameter and MMMode enumeration. The EA also uses an IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signals are calculated only once per bar, preventing duplicate entries on the same bar. The SignalBar parameter allows users to select which bar's values to use for signal calculation, defaulting to 1 (the most recently completed bar).

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金管理比例或固定手数
parameters.description_en: Money management ratio or lot size

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 手数计算模式（可用保证金/余额/扣除浮亏/固定手数）
parameters.description_en: Lot calculation mode (Free Margin/Balance/Margin Loss/Balance Loss/Fixed Lot)

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 用于信号计算的K线索引

pros: 使用Hull移动平均线，相比普通MA延迟更小、平滑度更高，能更快捕捉趋势变化
具备完整的资金管理系统，支持五种仓位计算模式，灵活适应不同交易需求
采用新K线检测机制，避免同一根K线上重复计算信号和重复开仓
买卖方向可独立开关控制，允许只做单边趋势或仅用于平仓
止损止盈参数齐全，且支持反向信号平仓，双重出场保护
pros_en: Uses Hull Moving Average which has less lag and more smoothness than standard MA, capturing trend changes faster
Comprehensive money management system with five position sizing modes, flexibly adapting to different trading needs
New bar detection mechanism prevents redundant signal calculation and duplicate entries on the same bar
Buy and sell directions can be independently toggled, allowing single-direction trading or close-only mode
Complete stop loss and take profit parameters with reverse-signal closing for dual exit protection
cons: 没有持仓检查逻辑，可能在同方向已持仓时重复开仓，导致仓位叠加风险
缺少点差过滤，在点差较大时入场可能导致滑点损失，尤其在高时间周期切换时
HMA周期固定为13且不可自适应，在波动率变化大的市场中可能产生大量虚假信号
止损1000点和止盈2000点的默认值偏大，可能不适合所有品种和波动环境
没有追踪止损机制，在趋势行情中无法锁定浮动利润
cons_en: No position check logic — may open duplicate positions in the same direction, leading to position stacking risk
No spread filter — entering during high spread conditions may cause slippage losses, especially when switching timeframes
HMA period is fixed at 13 with no adaptivity, potentially generating many false signals in highly variable volatility markets
Default stop loss of 1000 points and take profit of 2000 points are large and may not suit all instruments and volatility environments
No trailing stop mechanism to lock in floating profits during trending moves
improvements: 增加持仓检查逻辑，在开仓前确认同方向是否已有持仓，避免仓位重复叠加
增加点差过滤和波动率自适应机制，在高点差或低波动环境下暂停交易
添加追踪止损功能，在趋势行情中动态锁定利润
improvements_en: Add position check logic before opening trades to confirm no existing same-direction positions, preventing position stacking
Add spread filter and volatility adaptation mechanism to pause trading during high spread or low volatility conditions
Add trailing stop functionality to dynamically lock in profits during trending markets

risk_points: 缺少持仓检查，可能导致同方向重复开仓造成仓位叠加风险
固定止损止盈不适应所有市场环境，极端行情下止损可能不够
没有点差过滤，高点差时段入场可能导致额外损失
risk_points_en: No position check may cause duplicate same-direction entries leading to position stacking risk
Fixed stop loss and take profit may not adapt to all market conditions; stops may be insufficient in extreme moves
No spread filter may cause additional losses when entering during high-spread periods
